messages.subject: Re: Reading data from Hadoop or HDFS in R language
parts:
Hi,
this group is about RHadoop. Rhadoop has three packages. rmr and rhdfs allow you to read from HDFS, rhbase from Hbase. We hope to make it possible for rmr to read from Hbase in the near future.

Antonio

On Tuesday, November 20, 2012 1:01:21 PM UTC+1, Prabhanjana Guttal wrote:
Hi,
I wanted to know how can we read data from HDFS or Hadoop running on Ubuntu Operating system to R which is also running in Ubuntu OS.

Do we need to build any Java APIs or any standard packages available in R which reads the data directly from HDFS.

 

Note: Both R and Hadoop are running on Ubuntu OS.
 
regards,
Prabhanjana
